name: Corkscrew
description: Guidelines for traveling with corkscrew in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Corkscrews that contain a small foil-cutting blade are prohibited in carry-on baggage. Bladeless corkscrews are allowed.

checkedBag.reason: All types of corkscrews are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring corkscrew on a plane?

travelTips: Corkscrews that contain a small foil-cutting blade are prohibited in carry-on baggage. Bladeless corkscrews are allowed.

faq.question: Is corkscrew allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Corkscrew is not_allowed in carry-on luggage. Corkscrews that contain a small foil-cutting blade are prohibited in carry-on baggage. Bladeless corkscrews are allowed.

faq.question: Can you pack corkscrew in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Corkscrew is allowed in checked bags. All types of corkscrews are allowed in checked baggage.
